items.problem: `clientRegression` calls `gutRun` without `startLimitMs`, so a client regression test run of a game whose core settings have `UnitTestCore.startTimeLimitMs` and that never sends `PUT /started` is not ended at that limit and waits `runTimeLimitMs` plus the startup allowance, unlike `skills/client-core/modules/unit-test-core.md:137` and `skills/client-core/engines/godot.md:549` ("A native run that did not start ends with a failure"); it is in `ogw check`, not the `core` command

`ogw check` with the regression check alone calls `regressionTest` with `{ godot, evidence, runTimeLimitMs: limit }` and no `startTimeLimitMs` (only `gameChecks`, tools/src/commands/check/lib/loop.ts:128, passes it after this range), so `clientRegression` passes `startLimitMs: null` to `gutRun` (tools/src/commands/check/lib/regression.ts:192), and a client regression test run of a game whose core settings have `UnitTestCore.startTimeLimitMs` and that never sends `PUT /started` waits `runTimeLimitMs` plus the startup allowance, unlike `skills/client-core/modules/unit-test-core.md:137` and `skills/client-core/engines/godot.md:549`. `startTimeLimitMs` is optional in `ClientRunOptions` (regression.ts:122), so the type check does not catch the missing caller; it is in `ogw check`, not the `core` command

the did-not-start failure of the client regression test added in this range has no test: no test under tools/test/commands/check passes `startTimeLimitMs` or asserts `test run did not start within`; it is in `ogw check`, not the `core` command
